title: Geek Bar Pulse California Cherry 15000 Disposable Vape
description:
The California Cherry Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape reinvents the disposable vaping experience by skillfully fusing cutting-edge technology with a burst of delicious cherry flavor. With two power settings, the standard mode produces an astounding 15,000 puffs with a mesh coil that maximizes taste consistency and prolongs battery life.
The pulse mode boosts the airflow and output to 20W, providing denser vapor and a richer taste profile for up to 7,500 puffs, for those looking for that extra kick.
Unlock the New Flavor World
This disposable vaporizer maintains a strong nicotine level of 5% and delivers a powerful and fulfilling dose with each draw. Convenient USB Type-C connector allows for rapid recharges and longer usage of the 650mAh built-in battery. The preloaded 16ml e-liquid reservoir assures an abundant supply before replacement is needed.
With its inbuilt twin mesh coil and easy-to-use draw-activated system, the California Cherry Geek Bar Pulse 15000 promises to provide an amazing vaping experience while capturing the tantalizing flavor of juicy cherry.
A REVIEW OF CALIFORNIA CHERRY FLAVOR
Experience the Geek Bar Pulse California Cherry Vape taste as it takes center stage and transports you to a symphony of cherry delight. A blast of sweet cherry deliciousness is introduced on the inhale, enveloping your tongue in a luxurious hug, and a lingering, slightly tangy sweetness is left behind on the exhale. With every puff, you’re taken on a trip through flavor-filled orchards, experiencing rich, real cherries.
Additional Information
Regular Mode Max Puffs: 15000
Pulse Mode Max Puffs: 7500
Nicotine Strength: 5% (50mg)2
Prefilled Capacity: 16mL
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Charging Port: USB Type-C
Operation: Draw-Activation
FAQ
How do I know when the e-liquid is running low?
The device does not have a liquid level indicator, but you will notice a decrease in vapor production and flavor intensity when the e-liquid is running low.
Can I switch between power modes easily?
Yes, switching between standard mode and pulse mode is straightforward and allows you to customize your vaping experience according to your preference for either more puffs or denser vapor.
Is the Geek Bar Pulse California Cherry suitable for new vapers?
While the device is user-friendly with its draw-activated system, the 5% nicotine concentration is quite strong, making it more suitable for experienced vapers or those transitioning from traditional cigarettes.
Are there any safety features included in the Geek Bar Pulse California Cherry?
Yes, the device includes safety features such as short-circuit protection, overcharge protection, and low voltage protection to ensure safe and reliable operation.
